title: Nithari case: 13 death sentences, not 1 year of freedom - Koli's legal Odyssey
content: Surinder Koli, sentenced to death in 13 Nithari killings cases and once hours away from execution, spent nearly two decades fighting to prove his innocence. After the Allahabad high court acquitted him in 12 cases, the Supreme Court cleared him in the last case in November 2025. Koli, who often argued his own cases from jail, walked free after nearly 19 years behind bars. He was found dead in Haridwar on Friday, less than a year after his release.

title: Asian Games 2026 open in Nagoya with spectacular opening ceremony

title: ‘Will take body to campus’: Father demands arrests in IIT-Bombay suicide case

title: Atlanta man arrested after phone wipe; new ruling allows border searches
content: US border agents can now search traveler cellphones without reasonable suspicion or a warrant. A recent court ruling affirmed this broad authority at international borders. This decision follows an incident where a phone was wiped during an airport search. The ruling impacts traveler privacy and government access to electronic data. It highlights ongoing debates about digital device searches at the border.

title: No Dhoni, Kohli or Rohit: Pat Cummins names 'toughest' India player he faced

Across 25 Tests, he amassed 2,074 runs with a remarkable average of 49.38. title: MIT robot built a working laser cavity in under 30 minutes
content: Massachusetts Institute of Technology researchers developed a robotic optics laboratory.  This system autonomously assembles and aligns laser cavities with precision.  The robot can also correct experimental setups after they are disturbed.  This technology could accelerate testing for various optical devices and materials.  Future applications envision remote interaction with these automated research environments.

title: 312 years after first ‘typing’ patent, SAP CEO says prepare for 'Death of Keyboard'
content: SAP CEO Christian Klein envisions a future where traditional keyboards are replaced by advanced AI-driven voice recognition for data input. This shift promises to revolutionize employee interaction with enterprise software, enabling seamless communication through spoken commands. Additionally, AI agents are anticipated to unify various business operations, fostering increased efficiency. Companies should proactively adapt to these innovations and the dynamic geopolitical technology landscape.

title: Rod Stewart’s former LA estate sold in two deals totaling $86 million

The sprawling six-acre property was split into two parcels, with television producer David Zander acquiring the main mansion for $57 million. Meanwhile, Nick Kaiser purchased a smaller parcel complete with a historic cabin for $29 million. This notable sale underscores the ongoing allure of grand historic properties.

title: Mamata Banerjee's Rejinagar pick withdraws from bypolls contest, then retracts

title: Henry Ford built an American town in Amazon rainforest; sold it for $250,000
content: Henry Ford initiated the Fordlandia project in the lush Amazon rainforest of Brazil to secure a steady rubber supply. However, his corporate methods often clashed with local traditions and agricultural practices. The plantation faced numerous obstacles, including pests and diseases harming the rubber trees. Despite investing heavily over seventeen years, Fordlandia ultimately succumbed to failure, illustrating the challenges of integrating foreign business models within local ecosystems.

title: California removed creek barrier; salmon returned for first time since 1950s
content: A decades-long barrier blocking fish migration in Alameda Creek was removed in 2025.  This action reopened over twenty miles of upstream habitat for migratory fish.  Chinook salmon were documented in the newly accessible area shortly after the construction.  This marked the first access to this watershed section since the 1950s.  The project is part of a larger, nearly thirty-year restoration effort.
